traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. The trine makes this a natural strength: Charismatic motivation; action aligned with imagination. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Drive and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what drive and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
base: Action can give a meaningful feeling somewhere to go before every reason for it has been explained.

readerCopy.body: Action can give a meaningful feeling somewhere to go before every reason for it has been explained. When Mars trines Neptune, initiative can follow compassion, intuition, creativity, or conviction without requiring every emotion to become an argument first. Making something, helping, moving the body, or taking one useful step can reveal what thought alone has not clarified. The action works best when it expresses the feeling rather than demanding that the feeling justify itself.
